title: fix(app-shell): the metadata editor page tells its scoped inspector why it is read-only
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb2ejsWw32Bacu7MBXXjd2HN)_

Fixes #29079

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:元数据编辑页(Setup 的条目页，以及 Studio「全部元数据」下的 `/studio/包/metadata/flow/名称`)现在会把「为什么只读」告诉右侧的节点属性栏。属性栏显示的原因，就是编辑器上方提示条对当前原因说的那句话：只读软件包、锁定、缺少 `manage_metadata` 能力、代码包提供的条目、运行时只读的类型，以及安全目录的隔离墙。没有新增文案。
- **为什么改**:#28985 之后，Studio 自动化页的流程节点属性栏会解释灰掉的控件，但同一个属性栏放在元数据编辑页上时，宿主不传原因，控件仍然灰着却没有任何说明。
- **风险与回滚**:低。只多传一个可选属性 `readOnlyReason`,且只传给按选中项打开的属性栏;可写时不传，渲染与之前相同。未选中时的默认属性栏不变。回滚即还原本 PR。
- **先看**:`ResourceEditPage.tsx` 中 `formReadOnly` 下方新增的 `inspectorReadOnlyReason`(原因的先后顺序与上方提示条一致),以及 `InspectorComponent` 调用处新增的一行。
- **两分钟验证**:在 `ui/` 下运行 `pnpm exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/ResourceEditPage.inspectorReadOnlyReason-29079.test.tsx`,预期 6 个测试全绿;去掉调用处那一行后 5 个变红。
- **需要你做的**:无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **`ResourceEditPage` derives `inspectorReadOnlyReason`** next to `formReadOnly` and passes it to the scoped inspector (`InspectorComponent`) as `readOnlyReason`, the prop #28985 added to `MetadataInspectorProps`. The sentence is the one the page's own notice gives for the cause in force, in the notices' order:
  1. the walled security catalog: `engine.catalog.readOnly.walled`;
  2. a read-only package (Studio's "All metadata" area): `engine.studio.pkg.readonlyHint`, the sentence Studio's Automations pillar passes;
  3. a lock: the lock banner's title, then the `lockReason` the server serves;
  4. a declaration-only catalog: its `engine.catalog.declaredOnly.hint` sentence;
  5. a caller without `manage_metadata`: `engine.edit.capabilityReadOnly`;
  6. an item a code package ships: `engine.edit.artifactLockedBanner`;
  7. a type that is read-only at runtime: `engine.edit.readOnlyTypeBanner`.
  An editable page passes none.
- **No string is new**, so no i18n pack changes: every sentence is an existing key the page already shows above the editor.
- **The no-selection default inspector is unchanged.** `MetadataDefaultInspectorProps` declares no `readOnlyReason`, and widening it is outside this card.

## Deviations

The card asks for three causes on the node inspector: no write access, a pending walled decision, and view mode pointing at Edit. Measured on `main` `87d6baef`, only the first can reach the flow node inspector on this page:

- **Walled** applies only to the security catalog types (`position`, `permission`, `capability`), and none of them registers a scoped inspector. The page still names the wall first, so an inspector a host registers for one of those types gets the right sentence and not the capability one. The test pins that through a host inspector registered for `position`.
- **View mode does not reach a scoped inspector.** The inspector renders only beside a designer canvas. A designer type enters editing as soon as the item can be written (the designer auto-on effect), stays in editing after save and reset, and has no Edit button (the Edit button renders only when there is no preview). A sentence pointing at Edit would point at nothing, so view mode passes no reason. The seat accepted this shape before code.

## Tests

- **New: `ResourceEditPage.inspectorReadOnlyReason-29079.test.tsx`, 6 cases.** The real page, gates and `FlowInspector` → `FlowNodeInspector`; only the canvases (to emit a selection) and the data reads are stubbed. Each case opens the item, selects on the canvas and reads the accessible description of the node inspector's reason group:
  - a writable flow: no reason group, and Remove node is enabled;
  - a read-only package's area, a caller without `manage_metadata`, a locked item with a served reason, and a flow a code package ships: each shows its own sentence;
  - the walled catalog: a host inspector registered for `position` receives `readOnly` and the wall's sentence.
- **Red on main:** the same file on `87d6baef` reads 5 failed, 1 passed (only the writable control passes).
- **Ablation:** deleting the `readOnlyReason={inspectorReadOnlyReason}` line through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` reads 5 failed, 1 passed; restored, blob equals `HEAD` and `git diff HEAD` is empty.
